root_cause: The worker's SQS event source mapping was disabled outside Terraform at 23:44:08Z (State=Disabled), so nothing invokes the worker and orders stay PENDING. The worker role is also missing s3:PutObject on the receipts bucket, so workers fail with AccessDenied before writing receipts.
remediation_steps: Run terraform plan to confirm the drift, then terraform apply to re-enable the mapping.
